text: Core courses Design Sketch, Design Color, Design Composition (Two-dimensional Composition, Color Composition, Three-Dimensional Composition), Design Expression (Technique Methods of Hand Painting, Computer Aided Design (CAD), Modeling), Engineering Cartography, Man-Machinery Engineering, Design Material and Manufacturing Technique, Product Design (Design Process and Methods, Design Semiology, Research and Development of Product Design, Design Management) . Objective This objective is to train students to be high-quality personnel with professional skill. After graduation, they will take the innovation of products as a focal point, working in the fields of relevant design, management, scientific research or teaching. Therefore, students are mainly required to study the basic theory and knowledge of industrial design; have acquaintance with the design principle of application models and its methods to handle with different products’ models and colors, form and appearance, structure and function, structure and materials, appearance and workmanship, products and people, products and environment or market. At the same time, they have the basic ability of integrating all these facts and relations into products’ model-design. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 190 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted.
